topline.thesis: Founder-directed full-site visual + UX + redundancy audit. Walked the real journey (hero -> games -> join -> member portal) across all 5 clusters, not registry labels. The site is feature-dense and structurally mature (98+ pages, ~150 JS modules) but visually under-finished in three high-traffic places: (1) game cards render as bare radial gradients with no cover art on the #1 CTA path; (2) the signed-in member portal is a flat dark panel while the anonymous funnel pages glow premium — the experience INVERTS where it should reward; (3) the intelligence pages (oracle/studio-pulse/nervous-system) ship chart skeletons that still read as 'Loading...' to the public, and the three pages heavily overlap. Biggest redundancy wins: 6 byte-identical pathways/* templates (165 lines each) collapse to one filterable page; brand+press are the same media-kit; member/members/vault-member/vault-portal naming is a maze. Premise corrections applied: ranks/ ALREADY uses rank-orb (demoted), velocity-series data shipped S198 (data-viz item scoped to the still-dormant heatmap/constellation), pwa-install already live.

items.title: Render the dormant intelligence visuals (heatmap + constellation + insights) instead of 'Loading...'
items.why: oracle/ and studio-pulse/ ship the markup for a 60-day signal heatmap, a project-constellation network graph, and an auto-insights list, but on the public deploy they sit at 'Reading the data...' / 'Loading 60-day grid...' placeholders. A studio whose whole pitch is 'we are alive and measurable' that shows perpetual loading spinners reads as broken (CANON-031 honesty). The velocity series data already exists (api/velocity-series.json, shipped S198) so the wiring cost is low; the visual payoff is the single most premium-dashboard upgrade available.
items.recipe: In studio-pulse-live.js + oracle-insights-compute.js: render the heatmap as a CSS-grid (7 rows x ~9 weeks) with intensity bound to api/velocity-series.json daily counts + hover tooltip (date + count); render the constellation as an inline SVG node graph (nodes = projects from public-intelligence.json, edges = shared-universe links) with hover labels; populate #oracle-insights with 3-5 derived bullets (peak day, trend %, top mover). Add a CSS shimmer skeleton so a slow fetch never shows blank/raw 'Loading' text.

L1.recipe: Replace every 'Loading...' literal with a shimmer skeleton block so nothing reads as broken; wire the heatmap to existing velocity-series.json only.

L2.recipe: L1 + render heatmap with hover tooltips, the SVG constellation graph, and the derived insights bullet list.

L3.recipe: L2 + animated draw-in on scroll, click-to-drill on constellation nodes (open the project), and a 'last updated' freshness pill bound to the feed timestamp.

items.premiseEvidence: Agent confirmed placeholder text in oracle/index.html (#oracle-insights, 60-day grid) and studio-pulse/index.html (#studio-living-window). build-velocity-series.mjs (S198) confirmed to emit api/velocity-series.json so chart data is present.

items.title: Make the signed-in portal first-load premium + personal (the experience currently INVERTS)
items.why: The anonymous funnel pages (join/, invite/, membership/) glow with radial gradients, animated orbs and gradient panels, but the signed-in /vault-member/ dashboard renders on a flat var(--page-bg) dark panel with a static placeholder below the profile card. The reward for joining is a downgrade in polish, which directly undercuts SOUL non-negotiable #2 ('membership must feel real, like entry into something'). There is no 'you're N pts from <next tier>', no streak, no this-week's-challenge moment, so the portal feels like a settings page, not a vault.
items.recipe: Above the fold in vault-member/index.html: add a personalization cluster bound to session — (a) tier card with current pts + next-tier + animated progress arc (reuse rank-orb.js already proven on ranks/), (b) login-streak badge when streak>=3, (c) 'this week's challenge' micro-card with XP reward. Style the dashboard header with a tier-colored gradient + left-border accent (gold Sparked / purple Eternal / silver Free) and a 'member since' / founding-member badge. Gate everything on session presence (account-chip presence-first pattern).

L1.recipe: Tier-colored gradient header + 'N pts to <next tier>' line + progress bar. No new feeds.

L2.recipe: L1 + rank-orb progress arc, streak badge, this-week challenge micro-card; emit engagement:portal_personalized RUM event.

L3.recipe: L2 + 'your focus this session' smart suggestion, recently-unlocked achievement reel, and a Browse-Members CTA into /members/.

items.premiseEvidence: Agent confirmed static dashboard section + generic dark panel in vault-member/index.html ~351-400 vs premium glow in join/. rank-orb.js confirmed already wired in ranks/index.html so reuse path exists. 'pace to next tier' logic strings exist in JS but are not surfaced visually in the portal.

items.title: Give every game a real cover tile (cards are bare radial gradients on the #1 CTA path)
items.why: The games grid is the most-trafficked conversion surface and every card is a colored radial-gradient blur behind text — no cover art, no distinctive imagery. It reads uniform and impersonal, the opposite of 'studio-owned, not generic' (SOUL anti-goal). This is the highest single-issue visual lift on the site because it's the first thing a player evaluates. sharp@0.34.5 is already a trusted devDep (S196) so bespoke SVG->PNG cover tiles can be generated build-time with zero new deps.
items.recipe: Author one bespoke SVG cover per game (title lockup + genre motif + brand-consistent palette), rasterize to PNG via the existing sharp pipeline, and render as a card hero image with a gradient overlay for text legibility. Apply uniformly across games/index.html cards AND each game page hero. Keep the radial gradient as the loading fallback. Wire into build:check so a game without a cover fails the gate.

L1.recipe: Polish the existing gradients: add a genre glyph/wordmark watermark + consistent overlay so cards stop looking identical.

L2.recipe: Bespoke SVG->PNG cover tile per game via sharp; image + overlay on cards and game-page heroes; fallback gradient on load.

L3.recipe: L2 + subtle parallax/tilt on hover, animated cover variants for SPARKED titles, and an OG-image reuse so social shares carry the same cover.

items.premiseEvidence: Agent confirmed game cards use radial-gradient heroes with no cover images across games/index.html. sharp SVG->PNG capability confirmed available from S196 (46 bespoke OG cards shipped same-day, zero new deps).

items.title: Interactive Universe Depth Map — node graph of game/project/lore connections
items.why: The site repeatedly hints at a shared universe (Voidfall, DreadSpike, Solara, lore gates) but exposes it only as prose. An interactive node-graph that shows how titles and lore connect — with a few public edges visible and more hinted behind membership — turns flat copy into explorable depth and is a genuine immersion differentiator no indie-studio site in this category has. It also creates a natural membership pull (unlock hidden connections).
items.recipe: Build an inline-SVG / canvas force-ish node graph (no heavy dep — reuse the constellation renderer from item 1). Seed nodes/edges from a public data file (universe-graph.json): games, projects, lore entities. Public visitors see 2-3 confirmed edges + locked/blurred nodes; signed-in members see more. Place on a new /universe/ surface and embed a teaser on the homepage. Founder-verify edges before publish (lore canon must be founder-reviewed).

L1.recipe: Static SVG constellation of public titles with hover labels, no interactivity, on homepage teaser only.

L2.recipe: Full interactive /universe/ graph with locked/unlocked nodes by session, click-to-open, founder-verified edges.

L3.recipe: L2 + animated reveal of new edges as titles ship, lore-gate tie-in, and member-only deep edges with a 'you unlocked' moment.

items.premiseEvidence: Universe/lore references confirmed across homepage (Voidfall teaser) and lore-gates.js. No interactive relationship visualization exists. Memory note: hand-curated lore/canon edges require founder review (handcurated-truth-needs-founder-review).

First-impression immersion is left on the table on the studio's most important page. will-change + contain:paint are already applied so parallax is low-jank.

Keep prefers-reduced-motion honored.

L3.recipe: L2 + pointer-reactive glow drift and a one-time first-visit cinematic that self-disables after first view.

items.title: Differentiate (or unify) oracle / studio-pulse / nervous-system — three near-identical 'intelligence' pages
items.why: All three render the same ecosystem snapshot (project cards, health, focus) and a public visitor can't tell why they exist separately. This is the largest conceptual redundancy on the site. Either give each a distinct, signposted job or unify them into one dashboard with modes — but the current three-near-duplicate-landings state is the worst option.
items.recipe: Decision-first: assign distinct roles — Pulse = live heartbeat (cards + current focus), Oracle = deep read (velocity, forecasts, insights from item 1), Nervous System = signal digest (tiles + decisions). Add a shared sub-nav across the three so they read as one suite, de-duplicate the shared project-card block to a single include, and cross-link. L3 = collapse to one /studio-pulse/ with mode tabs and 301 the other two (Worker Layer 0c).

L2.recipe: L1 + extract the duplicated project-card block to one shared renderer and specialize each page's unique content.
